info: **How to use it with the copilot:** click anywhere on the chart to choose a habitat condition (the dark-cyan marker and the copilot's Oxygen and Pressure fields follow your click; you can also type the values). Then press **Ask copilot**: the application ranks the investigations closest to that point, and the language model explains the ranking using only cited records and report passages. Dots near the marker mean well-covered conditions; a marker in an empty area means the answer rests on distant tests. The ranking is not only distance: it weighs five criteria (O₂ closeness, pressure closeness, fire-safety pillar, fuel type, data richness), so a study can rank high with few dots near the marker. After you ask, the studies in the answer stay highlighted and the rest fade.
